sectionsRetiredOct1.title: Make This Website an App On Your Home Screen

items.label: Why bother
items.detail: It opens full screen like an app, with no address bar, and you stop hunting for the link all week. Takes about ten seconds.

items.label: iPhone
items.detail: Open this page in your browser. Tap the three dots or lines at the bottom right. Tap the share button at the bottom, the square with the arrow pointing up. Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.

items.label: Android
items.detail: Open this page in your browser. Tap the three dots at the top right. Tap Add to Home screen, then tap Add or Install.

items.label: PGA WEST Private Clubhouse
items.detail: 55-955 PGA Blvd., La Quinta, California 92253. Home base for the week: registration, breakfast, scoring, and the evening events.

items.label: La Quinta Cliffhouse
items.detail: 78250 Highway 111, La Quinta, California 92253. Monday's teams dinner.

items.label: La Quinta Resort & Club
items.detail: A Waldorf Astoria Resort. 49-499 Eisenhower Drive, La Quinta, California 92253. Championship golf, resort pool, and a full-service spa.

items.label: Extending your stay
items.detail: Tell your Team Captain Host. The resort will contact you directly to confirm availability and rates.

items.label: Monday, Nicklaus Private
items.detail: Two-person scramble net. 35% of the low handicap player plus 15% of the high. Four drives per player minimum. Maximum score of gross double bogey. Men play the blue tees, ladies the red. Scoring code PRTINV26.

items.label: Monday Member Shootout
items.detail: 25 teams, two members per club, lowest index. Three holes on the Nicklaus Private. Teams split into two groups by combined handicap index. Alternate shot gross. Group A plays Hole 1 then Hole 9, Group B plays Hole 9 then Hole 1, and the final hole is 18. Four teams advance from each group after the first hole, two after the second, and the last four play the final. Men play the blue tees, women the red.

items.label: Tuesday, Palmer Private
items.detail: Two-person shamble net. 70% of your GHIN handicap index. Four drives per player minimum. Maximum score of net double bogey. Men play modified blue tees, ladies the red.

items.label: The Tuesday Shoot-Out
items.detail: The top three scores and ties play two holes, 10 and 18, two members per club, lowest index. Alternate shot gross. Teams are eliminated on Hole 10 depending on the size of the field, and the last two standing play Hole 18. Men play the blue tees, women the red.

items.label: Shoot-Out rules, both days
items.detail: Ties are broken by a chip-off. The player who did not hole the last putt chips, and the ball has to finish on the green. Waiting teams turn their backs to the hole. On the first hole with a bigger field the closest team putts first. On the final hole, and with a smaller field, the farthest team putts first. Announce what you lie, what you are putting for, and your final score.

items.label: Team Captains
items.detail: Captains play in member groups each day in fivesomes, playing their own ball in a skins game.

items.label: How the groups work
items.detail: Monday and Tuesday mix the groups. You and a fellow member are paired with two members from an affiliate club.

items.label: PGA WEST
items.detail: Country club casual. Summer attire is appropriate. No denim. Jackets are not required at social events.

items.label: Sunday opening party
items.detail: Light the Night in White. White attire, no denim.

items.label: La Quinta Cliffhouse
items.detail: Smart or elegant casual.

items.label: Flights
items.detail: Your Team Captain Host books the team's airfare from your completed Player Profile Sheet. Booking your own trip around the event? The club credits your member account up to the average team ticket price. Spouse airfare is booked and paid separately.

items.label: Ground transport
items.detail: Each team has rental vehicles for the airport, the course, and the resort. Please plan designated drivers.

items.label: Baggage for Players
items.detail: Pay your own baggage fees and keep the receipts. They come back as a credit on your member account. Golf clubs count as baggage.

items.label: Driving yourself
items.detail: Local members who skip the team vehicles are reimbursed mileage or a fixed amount.

items.label: Invited and encouraged
items.detail: We would love your spouse or significant other to join you for the week. The trip is planned for adults, so we are not able to host children or pets.

items.label: Practice and spouse rounds
items.detail: Your Team Captain Host can schedule additional tee times at Palmer Advantage rates, $35 to $50 depending on the course.

items.label: Your Team Captain Host
items.detail: Every club captain, with their mobile and email, is on the Teams tab. They are your first call for anything during the week.
